analysis: The question pertains to the use of alpha-1 adrenergic blockers for symptomatic relief in benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). Both retrieved medical knowledge entries confirm that adrenergic alpha-1 receptor antagonists are used to treat BPH. Prazosin, while also an alpha-1 blocker, is more commonly associated with the treatment of hypertension.
